question: With which bank has the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) partnered to strengthen India’s startup ecosystem?
solution:
The correct answer is __**YES BANK**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **DPIIT has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with YES BANK to strengthen India’s startup ecosystem.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The collaboration aims to provide market linkages, funding access, mentorship, and infrastructure support for product startups.**
 
• Startups will benefit from YES BANK’s HeadStartup program offering financial solutions such as working capital and credit access.
 
• This partnership supports India’s startup ecosystem and fosters innovation-led growth as part of the Startup India initiative.
 
• The MoU was signed in the presence of senior officials from DPIIT and YES BANK, marking a significant step for emerging startups.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• YES BANK__

 __
 
• Founded in 2004, headquartered in Mumbai, with a focus on providing innovative financial solutions to startups and businesses.
 
 
 
• DPIIT__
 __
 
• The Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade, a government body focused on fostering industrial growth and innovation in India.
 
 
 
• Startup India__
 
 
• Launched by the Indian government to promote and support the growth of startups through funding, tax benefits, and other resources.
